author: KevineCove
body:
I'm pretty disconnected from the Gilga meta but Surtr's Cuirass might be better than Avalon Armor, you could maybe get Pumpkinless Legs next month, and there are a few shields to look out for, namely Arisen Shield and Spiked Greatshield (from this event!)

As far as weapons, you'll eventually want Excalibur and maybe Yelmogus Greatsword.

I don't know what combination of these go together for specific builds and which are better for Ursa vs Hercules.

In terms of offensive and defensive accessories I think Arisen Arch Gizmo and Gadget are both significantly better than Carl's Ring or Immortal's.

I did run GUrsa while I was trying to reach level 50 in Blade of Finesse, I used Omega Olympian armor and legs and Tarnished King's Crown, plus Celestial Hammer. I don't think these have much utility outside of PvP though.

author: eserz
body:
Gilga Herc? The Spiked Shield (from arisen Rhada) and Trifecta Greatsword (from Trifecta maximus) substantially boost Spiked shield builds, you would lose a little ward compared to a celestial axe but the passive bonuses should absolutely make up for it and they're available right now.

For Gilga Ursa the Cursed Pendrake set and Cursed Excalibur from Avalon event are pretty amazing (BiS maybe?) but that's as far as my knowledge goes.

author: frosmayn
body:
You have 250k ward for your raid build shown in the image you posted... But isn't it naturally much higher for PvP due to HP and mana being scaled up?

Some specs, amities and items/buffs give bonuses for territory defence. I don't know if those directly effect ward but it could also explain why some people (assuming they are of similar AL to you) seem really tanky in settlement PvP
